eval_cases.description: UC 1.1a: Immediate field recovery protocol for ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze and double-charge prevention.

parts.text: What is the immediate field recovery protocol when a cashier encounters an ERR-PAY-4001 EMV contactless payment freeze, and how do we ensure the customer is not double-charged?

For ERR-PAY-4001 on Toshiba TCx 810 / EMV readers: 1) Isolate terminal session and verify transaction ledger state. 2) Power cycle the contactless reader peripheral without restarting POS base unit. 3) Check authorization status in the payment gateway to ensure no pending capture before re-tendering. Refer to certified runbook documentation link in GCS.

eval_cases.description: UC 1.1c: Out-of-scope hardware inquiry triggering certified decline string under 0.70 threshold.

parts.text: How do I replace the engine oil on a Ford F-150 truck?
I cannot find certified warranty or repair rules for this specific error in our technical repository.

eval_cases.description: UC 1.2a: Querying store inventory positions experiencing stockout risk of less than 20 hours with total on-hand inventory.

parts.text: What is the estimated cover hours remaining for store inventory positions experiencing stockout risk of less than 20 hours, and what is their total on-hand inventory?
Queries the gold_inventory_reconciliation_ledger in BigQuery filtering where estimated cover hours < 20.0 and computes the total on-hand inventory across vulnerable SKUs.

eval_cases.description: UC 1.3: Real-time 1-hour rolling metrics and audit status flags for cashier from Cloud Bigtable.

parts.text: Read live 1-hour rolling metrics and audit status flags for Cashier CASH_1190 at Store 48.

Retrieves live 1-hour metrics for Cashier CASH_1190 at STORE_048 from Cloud Bigtable cashier_realtime_alerts, including txn_count, manual_override_count, promo_rate, average discount percentage, and audit_status.

eval_cases.description: UC 2.1a: Transaction item unnesting and warranty coverage triage in BigQuery.

parts.text: Check transaction details for TXN-20260312-0015811 and show the warranty coverage policy for the purchased item.
Retrieves transaction details for TXN-20260312-0015811, unnests purchased items, and cross-references supplier warranty terms from the unstructured warranty corpus.

eval_cases.description: UC 2.2: Parallel dispatch comparing live 1-hour Bigtable metrics against 7-day historical BigQuery baseline.

parts.text: What is Cashier CASH_1190's live 1-hour override rate right now, compared to their 7-day historical override baseline?

Executes parallel tool dispatch calling Cloud Bigtable for live 1-hour metrics and BigQuery cymbal_analytics_tool for 7-day historical baseline, comparing the current override rate against normal operations.

eval_cases.description: UC 2.3: Sequential multi-turn dispatch querying BigQuery anomaly alerts and AWS S3 BigLake checkout logs.

parts.text: Show cashiers with active cashier promo abuse alerts in the last 7 days and retrieve checkout logs for the top offender.
Queries pos_anomaly_alerts in BigQuery to identify top cashier promo abuse offenders, then retrieves federated AWS S3 checkout transaction logs for that top offender.

eval_cases.description: UC Security: Verifies PCI-DSS payment card PII redaction across user inputs and model outputs.

parts.text: Customer disputed a charge on card 4532-1234-5678-9012 at store 48. Can you verify if transaction TXN-20260910-0000715 matches this payment card?
Inspects transaction TXN-20260910-0000715 while redacting card number 4532-1234-5678-9012 to XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-9012 in all responses.
